note_manual: 2026-11-24 — 12-page Elsevier article (Eur. J. Pharm. Biopharm. 69 (2008) 496–507), no SI. Figure read-outs are in digitized.csv (Fig. 4 markers 16 + Fig. 3 bars 32 + Fig. 5 markers 13 + the two dotted lines in each Fig. 5 panel); the Fig. 4 x read-out reproduces the printed Table 1 CAB ratios and their SD, which validates the axis calibration.
